title: Keynote Presentation: Winning before EVs: A faster path through profit-led adoption
gist: This is a member-only video page for ION Energy Systems CEO Jorge Diaz Schneider's Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote, 'Winning before EVs: A faster path through profit-led adoption'. Only the title is available. The rest of the page lists related Benchmark sessions, including Chinese OEMs in Europe and Africa-focused panels on the Lobito Corridor, critical-minerals regulation and financing.

insights.claim: ION Energy Systems CEO Jorge Diaz Schneider's Benchmark Summit 2026 London keynote argued that batteries can win 'before EVs' through a faster, profit-led adoption path, rather than waiting for mass EV uptake. The page is member-only, so the keynote's evidence and target segments are not given.
insights.speaker: Jorge Diaz Schneider , CEO , ION Energy Systems
insights.so_what: Battery demand from applications that pay back on economics alone could arrive sooner than EV-led demand, which is worth watching for battery-system suppliers.
insights.quote: Winning before EVs: A faster path through profit-led adoption

insights.claim: Benchmark's related-session listing says the role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market is a topic of increasing interest, with senior EV analyst George Whitcombe discussing it with senior editor Matthew Bird.
insights.speaker: Jorge Diaz Schneider , CEO , ION Energy Systems
insights.so_what: Chinese OEM share gains in European EVs are a watch item for European automakers and for which regions the battery supply chain serves.
insights.quote: The role of Chinese OEMs in Europe's growing EV market is a topic of increasing interest.
insights.locator: China's role in Europe EV market

insights.claim: A Benchmark panel on energy-transition geopolitics looked at EMEA's role in the global energy transition and at how international partnerships, trade policies and initiatives such as the Lobito Corridor are shaping battery and EV supply chains and opportunities to collaborate with African countries.
insights.speaker: Jorge Diaz Schneider , CEO , ION Energy Systems
insights.so_what: The Lobito Corridor is a policy-driven route that could change African critical-mineral trade flows to Western buyers.
insights.quote: initiatives such as the Lobito Corridor are shaping battery and EV supply chains
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Understanding the New Landscape for Energy Transition Geopolitics

insights.claim: A Benchmark panel looked at the regulatory frameworks, policies and strategic incentives shaping growth in EV batteries and critical minerals across Africa.
insights.speaker: Jorge Diaz Schneider , CEO , ION Energy Systems
insights.so_what: African policy incentives and regulation shape the risk and return of mineral projects on the continent.
insights.quote: Regulatory frameworks, policies, and strategic incentives shaping growth in EV batteries and critical minerals across Africa.
insights.locator: Panel Discussion: Regulation and Policy Frameworks for Critical Minerals
